summaries: A global solar storm hits Earth, destroying electronics and superheating the atmosphere. The main character dodges falling power lines and slips inside a concrete parking garage, but the entrance doors begin to melt shut.

Trapped in a parking garage during a solar storm, the main character uses a rubber mat to blast through a scalding steam barrier to reach basement level three. Once down there, broken water pipes flood the room while live high-voltage cables snap overhead, electrifying the water surrounding them.
arc.title: Solar Storm Crisis
